title: Dyson Daniels' late steal sends Hawks through as NBA Cup group winners
excerpt: Australian guard Dyson Daniels intercepted a pass with 3.8 seconds left as Atlanta edged Boston 87-86 to top NBA Cup Group C.
content_html:
Australian guard Dyson Daniels picked off a Jayson Tatum pass with 3.8 seconds remaining to seal an 87-86 win for the Atlanta Hawks over the Boston Celtics in Boston, a result that made Atlanta the winner of NBA Cup Group C.

The game was played at TD Garden on Friday night US time, Saturday morning AEDT. It was Atlanta's fifth win in a row and lifted the Hawks to 12-6 for the season, while Boston slipped to 12-7.

How the finish unfolded

Nickeil Alexander-Walker drove for a layup to put Atlanta ahead 85-83 with 54.3 seconds left. Tatum then stripped Alexander-Walker with about nine seconds to go, giving Boston a chance to tie or win.

Moments later Daniels, 23, read Tatum's pass and took it away for his fourth steal of the night. Alexander-Walker was fouled and made both free throws for an 87-83 lead, and a Derrick White three-pointer at the buzzer only cut the final margin to one.

Atlanta had trailed 29-14 after the first quarter and fell as far as 17 points behind before half-time. The Hawks won the third quarter 31-18, and a driving floater from Daniels late in that term gave them their first lead of the game at 70-69.

The numbers

Daniels finished with five points, six rebounds, five assists and four steals without a turnover in 37 minutes, according to Basketball Australia's Aussies in the NBA report. The haul took him to 55 steals in 18 games, the most per game in the league.

Jalen Johnson led Atlanta with 24 points and Alexander-Walker added 20. Tatum scored 20 for Boston, and centre Neemias Queta pulled down 22 rebounds. Boston turned the ball over 26 times, with Atlanta credited with 12 steals.

Other Australians

Matisse Thybulle, who sits second in the league for steals per game, had four steals but no points for the Los Angeles Lakers in a 99-96 loss to the San Antonio Spurs, after the Lakers let slip a 20-point lead. Josh Green went scoreless from seven shots as the Utah Jazz lost 120-107 to the Denver Nuggets.

What's next

The Hawks visit the New York Knicks on Monday at 10am AEDT. According to Basketball Australia, their NBA Cup quarter-final is against the Philadelphia 76ers on 5 December AEDT.
